prompt: Use case: precise-object-edit. Image 1 is the edit target, a green sequoia foliage photograph. Image 2 identifies ONLY the foreground spray to REMOVE from Image 1 for a background layer. Remove that central bright right-to-left needle spray and reconstruct only the hidden green foliage behind it. Preserve ALL surrounding foliage, positions, scale, square framing and upper-left lighting from Image 1 exactly. Crucial: EVERY leaf on this background plane must be equally SHARP and in focus, including deep shadows; no depth of field, no bokeh, no blur whatsoever. This background will be blurred later by the app. Green foliage only, no brown/orange wood, no insects, no water droplets, no text. Keep leaf sizes consistent with existing peripheral leaves. Do not reframe, zoom, or move surrounding leaves.
